obs: Oklahoma Natural Gas Co. v. Russell

"The amendment seems to have been introduced to prevent any question that such orders were within the section. It was superfluous as the original statute covered them. ... But it plainly was intended to enlarge not to restrict the law."

"That Congress changed its mind in 1972 and equalized the treatment of men and women does not, as the District Court concluded, constitute an admission by Congress that its previous policy was invidiously discriminatory."
